features: The front chassis is lowered by 10 mm relative to the main chassis.
An integrated vertical wall connects the two levels without a separate suspension or hanging platform.
Six 4 mm through holes in the wall provide small wire passages and remove material.
The breadboard is mounted transversely across the lowered front chassis.
A 0.8 mm recess, side guides, and a rear stop help locate the board.
Adhesive mounting is supplemented by backup strap slots.
Openings retain supporting rails and crossmembers while reducing material.
The fairing extends 8 mm beyond the original nose and is 90 mm wide.
Its curved side profile is approximated with short facets.
A nominal 1.5 mm vertical shell thickness and open underside limit added material.
The rear of the fairing rises 4 mm above its local chassis top.
The removable frame remains horizontal and is shifted 18 mm toward the center of the car.
Four separate hollow slanted supports connect original chassis mounting points to four distinct frame mounting points.
The frame includes weight relief windows, mounting seats, and backup strap slots.
Support projections avoid the defined motor mounting slots and power-switch opening.
The battery sits low in the rear chassis area.
The design reserves a 61.5 by 60 mm battery footprint based on existing dimensions and allowances.
Dedicated mounting holes and backup strap slots provide attachment options.
Battery and controller share the rear footprint at different heights.
Dedicated T-bar slots define the motor mounting interfaces.
A 9 by 15 mm opening locates the power switch.
Six 3 mm wire passages are positioned near the switch.
The motor mounting region retains the specified 2.5 mm chassis thickness.
Symmetric openings are distributed across selected chassis and frame regions.
Perimeter rails, crossmembers, screw lands, and functional mounting areas are retained.
The intended chassis remains one connected rigid body despite its two levels.
Four mounting holes are reserved for direct castor attachment.
No additional castor spacer is generated in the current design.
